items.text: Ma e wach mar Jehova Nyasaye mane obiro ne Zefania wuod Kushi, ma wuod Gedalia, ma wuod Amaria, ma wuod Hezekia e kinde loch Josia wuod Amon ruodh Juda.
mantie e piny mi lal nono,"
bende abiro tieko winy mafuyo e kor polo,
e ndalo manatiek dhano e wangʼ piny,"
kaachiel gi ji duto modak Jerusalem.
Abiro tieko jo-Baal duto mane odongʼ ka,
mi agol oko nying joma luwo nyiseche mopa kaachiel gi jodologi.
Bende abiro tieko ji duto makulore ewi tat udi
Ji duto makulore ka kwongʼore gi nying Jehova Nyasaye,
to bangʼe gikwongʼore gi nying Molek nyasach jo-Amon.
Ji duto moseweyo luwo Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo ok gimany Jehova Nyasaye kata mana penje wach."
Lingʼuru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto;
nikech odiechiengʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye chiegni.
"E odiechiengʼ mitimoe misango mar Jehova Nyasaye
anakum ji duto mamiel e laru mar dino cham,
kendo mapongʼo hekalu mar nyiseche manono
ywak noywagre koa e rangach miluongo ni Dhoranga Rech,
nduru noa e bath dala koma nyien,
kendo koko nogore matek koa e gode.
Gouru nduru un joma odak e mier moluoro chiro,
johala mau madongo duto ibiro yweyo oko,
kendo ji duto maloko ohand pesa notiek pep.
E ndalono abiro menyo Jerusalem gi teche
ka akumo joma odak kanyo madhi nyime gi timo timbe maricho,
ma gin joma chalo mana gi divai mawach;
ka giparo ni, 'Jehova Nyasaye ok notim
to ok gini madh divai moa kuomgi."
Ywagruok e odiechieng Jehova Nyasaye nobed malit,
kendo jolweny bende nogo koko kanyo.
enobed odiechieng mwodo lak kod rem malit,
bende enobed odiechieng chandruok gi kethruok,
enobed odiechiengʼ mopongʼ gi boche polo moimore,
kendo odiechiengʼ mopongʼ gi rumbi kod mudho.
To bende enobed odiechieng turumbete kod sigich mar lweny
nowinjre e mier madongo mochiel motegno,
kod ute mabeyo mag rito dala.
"Abiro kelo luoro kod achiedh-nade kuom oganda
kendo gibiro wuotho mana ka muofni,
nikech gisetimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
kendo nyimbiye igi nopukre oko ka ngʼwe.
To kata mana fedha mathoth kod dhahabu ma gin-go
Chiengʼ ma Jehova Nyasaye ngʼadoe bura,
nyiego mager ma en-go nowangʼ piny duto, mitiek pep."
Kamano e kaka notiek gik moko duto
modak e piny mana kadiemo wangʼ.

items.text: Juda kod Jerusalem ongʼadnigi bura machalre gi ogendini mamoko
Owachne Juda mondo opwodhre kuom richo
en odiechiengʼ ma ibiro teroue kuma bor ka mihudhwe mar cham.
Adier, chokreuru kapok mirima mager mar Jehova Nyasaye obiro kuomu,
kata kapok odiechiengʼ mar mirimbe ochopo.
Dwaruru Jehova Nyasaye, un ji duto mobolore manie piny,
kendo un ji duto matimo gik ma chik dwaro.
Dwaruru tim makare, kendo beduru gi chuny mobolore,
nimar dipo ka uyudo kar konyruok,
odiechiengno ma Jehova Nyasaye biro olo mirimbe kuom ji.
Odiechiengʼ tir Ashdod ibiro weyo nono
kendo Ekron ibiro pudh gi tiende.
Yaye jo-Kereth modak e dho nam,
Jehova Nyasaye nikodu gi wach kama:
Piny mantiere e dho nam kama jo-Kereth odakie biro bedo kar jokwath
Nobedi mar joma odongʼ mar dhood Juda;
kanyo gini yudie lek ma gikwae.
Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi biro ritogi
kendo obiro dwokonegi gweth mane ogwedhogigo.
Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel osingore kawacho kama,
Ma e kum ma jogi nonwangʼ kuom sunga margi,
kendo kuom yanyo kendo jaro jo-Jehova Nyasaye Maratego.
Jehova Nyasaye biro bedo nigi malich
ka oketho nyiseche duto e piny.
Ogendini duto modak e alwora mar dho nembe duto nolame,
ngʼato ka ngʼato nolame e pinygi owuon.
Enorie bade kuomu un joma odak yo nyandwat,
bende dala mar Nineve nodongʼ gunda
mi nobed motwo ka piny motimo ongoro.
Kweth mag jamni biro nindo piny motimo kanyo,
Ywakgi nowinjre ka wuok gie dirisni,
kite moger godo udi nomukre mabiwre e dhoudi,
Ma e dala maduongʼ mane odak gi kwe,
"An e kende kendo onge ngʼama ipimo koda."

kendo ok owinj kata puonj mora amora.

Kata kamano, ne pod gi timo sinani

Obiro bedo gi mor maduongʼ kuomi,
